title: The Organ That Grows Back
hook: Your liver is the only solid organ that can literally grow itself back.
script: Your liver is the only solid organ that can literally grow itself back. So what happens when surgeons cut away 65 percent of it? Within 8 to 10 weeks, both pieces regrow into full working organs. Instead of regrowing its original shape like a lizard, it swells into a smooth mass. At peak speed, it builds tissue faster than a developing human fetus. Scar tissue never takes over. An invisible biological sensor stops the expansion the exact second it reaches size.

captions: Would you donate part of your liver to save a stranger? Organ regeneration makes it possible.
Did you know human tissue could rebuild this fast?
The human body is stranger than it sounds.
